function: Excluded (function): the learned semi-supervised GAN classifies eight human gestures from 5G mmWave power-per-beam-pair measurements, a sensing inference; it designs no beams, waveforms, or resources (pp. 1, 7).
notes: Reason function, shown on p. 7: the 5G NR mmWave testbed sweeps beams from the vendor's fixed codebook (p. 7: "The vendor's predefined beamforming codebook includes a set of beam patterns"), and the 50x56 power grid "is then provided as input to the mmGAN for gesture classification"; the paper states "In this work, our focus is on the sensing aspect of ISAC." (p. 7). The learned task is gesture recognition (p. 1: "we propose mmGAN, a semi-supervised method for ISAC-based gesture recognition"), a sensing inference like the excluded positioning or activity tasks, not the ISAC problem of area 5 (beams, waveforms, and resources that serve sensing and communication) nor any other area. Not no_learning (the GAN discriminator is a trained CNN classifier) and not above_phy (gesture recognition is not a network-layer decision). The first page holds the title "mmGAN: Semi-Supervised GAN for Improved Gesture Recognition in mmWave ISAC Systems" and DOI 10.1109/OJCOMS.2025.3649235, so the PDF matches its DOI.
